# YourGP — Full Site Content

> A group of four GP-led general practices in Canberra, ACT. Vision: genuine care, clinical excellence.

This file contains the full content of ygp.au for language models. Financial detail (service fee split, expected earnings) is deliberately not published on the website or in this file; it is provided in the information pack on request.

---

## Home

YourGP is a group of four GP-led general practices across Canberra, built so that doctors want to stay for their whole careers — and patients get the care that makes possible.

- 4 clinics
- 40+ consulting rooms
- 40,000+ patients per year

**Looking for a GP?** We have practices at Crace, Denman Prospect, Lyneham and Garema Place in the city, plus dedicated skin cancer and vasectomy services. Each has its own site for appointments, fees, doctors and opening hours.

**Are you a GP?** We built YourGP around a simple idea: give doctors the services and facilities we would want to receive ourselves. Rooms with windows, real nursing and admin support, and the freedom to practise your way.

**Why it matters.** Good care depends on your GP knowing who you are, your history, and what matters to you. That relationship takes years to build — which is why we spend so much effort making YourGP somewhere doctors want to stay. Many of our GPs have looked after the same families for decades; some are now caring for a fourth generation.

---

## About — How YourGP is built

YourGP is owned by Dr John Deery and Dr Mel Deery. We run four general practices across Canberra — Crace, Denman Prospect, Lyneham and Garema Place in the city — along with two dedicated services, YourSkin CBR for skin cancer medicine and Canberra Vasectomy.

We have always believed the best patient care happens in GP-led practices. So rather than building a business that manages doctors, we built one that serves them: the systems, teams and spaces that let a GP practise excellent medicine, sustainably, for a very long time.

### Our values, in full

- **Caring** — We get the right things done, the right way.
- **Excellence** — We take pride in whatever we do.
- **Kaizen** — Continuous improvement. We experiment, learn fast, and improve every day.

### Four pillars, in order

They are sequential. Each one enables the next.

1. **Team Excellence** — Engaged employees are the foundation. Our reception, nursing and admin teams provide the service everything else rests on. *(Gallup Q12 > 4.5, 3% of time in training)*
2. **GP Service Excellence** — GPs are tenants receiving service and facilities, not employees being managed. Happy doctors do better medicine. *(GP NPS > 80, surveyed every four months)*
3. **Patient Experience** — Patients receive comprehensive, unhurried, evidence-based care, enabled by the two pillars above. *(Patient NPS > 80, Google average 4.8)*
4. **Sustainable Enterprise** — Margin protects the mission and funds reinvestment in all the pillars above. *(15% revenue growth p.a., 6% margin on fees)*

### Six questions, answered the same way every time

- **Q1 · Why we exist — Empower great care.** To provide the services and facilities we would want to receive ourselves, so our doctors can deliver exceptional patient care.
- **Q2 · How we behave — Care · Excellence · Kaizen.** We tell the truth kindly, we do what we say we will do, and we improve a little every day.
- **Q3 · What we do — Build the conditions.** We build the systems, teams and spaces that let a GP practise world-class medicine, efficiently and sustainably.
- **Q4 · How we will succeed — Four measured pillars.** Team, GP service, patient experience and a sustainable enterprise, each held to a number we publish to ourselves.
- **Q5 · What matters now — Clear goals.** We rally around a small set of clear short- and long-term goals, reviewed regularly.
- **Q6 · Who does what — The team serves the doctors.** Reception, nursing and admin exist to serve our GPs and their patients. The GP's part is clinical excellence and genuine care.

### Recognition

We are the preferred training location for GP registrars in Canberra, and take part in teaching medical students and new GPs. In 2020 we were recognised with an RACGP state award.

## Our practices

All practices can be reached on (02) 6109 0000 except Garema Place, which has its own line.

### YourGP@Crace — DPA
1/5 Baratta Street, Crace ACT 2911. Phone (02) 6109 0000.
20 consulting rooms, surgical theatre, nurse treatment rooms, Saturday morning clinic.
https://yourgpcrace.com.au

### YourGP@Denman — DPA
1B Felstead Vista, Denman Prospect ACT 2611. Phone (02) 6109 0000.
9 consulting rooms, surgical theatre, nurse treatment rooms.
https://yourgpdenman.com.au

### YourGP@Lyneham
62 Brigalow Street, Lyneham ACT 2602, next to Tilley's café. Phone (02) 6109 0000.
Nursing support on site.
https://yourgplyneham.com.au

### Garema Place Surgery
1st Floor, Florina Building, Garema Place, Canberra City ACT 2601. Phone (02) 6257 1000.
Part of YourGP since June 2026.
https://garemaplacesurgery.com.au

### YourSkin CBR — skin cancer medicine
Skin cancer checks, dermoscopy and on-site procedures, run by GPs holding masters degrees in skin medicine or advanced diplomas from an Australian skin cancer college. One doctor uses a FotoFinder for total body imaging. Available at Crace and Denman Prospect.
https://yourskincbr.com.au

### Canberra Vasectomy
No-scalpel vasectomy service for Canberra and the surrounding region. Phone (02) 6103 0434.
https://canberravasectomy.com.au

### DPA note for doctors
Crace and Denman Prospect are both in a Distribution Priority Area, which matters for moratorium obligations and international medical graduates. Lyneham and Garema Place are non-DPA.

## Contact

**Patients** should contact their practice directly — they hold the appointment book, records and billing.

- YourGP@Crace — 1/5 Baratta Street, Crace ACT 2911 — (02) 6109 0000
- YourGP@Denman — 1B Felstead Vista, Denman Prospect ACT 2611 — (02) 6109 0000
- YourGP@Lyneham — 62 Brigalow Street, Lyneham ACT 2602 — (02) 6109 0000
- Garema Place Surgery — 1st Floor, Florina Building, Garema Place, Canberra City ACT 2601 — (02) 6257 1000

**Doctors** — express interest via the Microsoft Form linked from every page, or email Dr John Deery at dr.john.deery@ygp.au.

**Nurses, admin and general enquiries** — the same form reaches us; note which role interests you. General business enquiries: admin@ygp.au.

**Clinical or urgent matters** are not monitored on these addresses. Contact your practice, or call 000 in an emergency.
